reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be the full finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary volume, including dimension zero. All approved section instances belong to the contract. Let mu:Measure E be any finite measure, with the actual IsFiniteMeasure instance; no probability, positive density or absolute-continuity assumption is imposed. Let D:Lp R 2 mu ->partialLinear[R] Lp E 2 mu be supplied and closable, with exactly this original graph: For every scalar class a and vector class H in these actual quotient spaces, (a,H) belongs to D.graph if and only if there exists a smooth compactly supported real function phi:E->R with a=phi almost everywhere for the stated measure and H=gradient(phi) almost everywhere for that same measure. D is the genuine real-linear partial gradient on its submodule domain; D.closure is its actual same-graph closure operator. Let f:E->R be C1 on the whole E, and assume actual hp:MemLp f 2 mu and hq:MemLp (gradient f) 2 mu. These are genuine a.e. strong measurability and finite scalar/vector L2 norm hypotheses for the actual function and its genuine Riesz gradient.
Then the ordered pair (hp.toLp f,hq.toLp (gradient f)) belongs to this SAME D.closure.graph.
The supplied original D is fixed before the C1 input and its L2 proofs. The conclusion links the actual f and actual gradient f classes, not arbitrary representatives chosen to make a graph relation hold. No compact support, global volume-L1 or norm(x)*f moment is required. Finiteness of the measure alone is not used as a substitute for either L2 hypothesis. No new operator/density certificate, approximation sequence, norm estimate, pointwise representative support identity, higher rough Hessian, spectral gap, core/adjoint or further functional inequality/composition is an explicit conclusion.
objects: Arbitrary actual finite measure mu, original supplied closable weighted partial gradient D with exact smooth compact graph; actual global C1 real f and its genuine Riesz gradient; actual MemLp scalar/vector proofs hp,hq and their ordered quotient pair in closure graph.
domains: Full finite real Hilbert/Borel E with ordinary volume available and dimension0 retained. mu arbitrary finite,including zero/singular,not necessarily probability/Gibbs. Scalar Lp R 2 mu and vector Lp E 2 mu are true AE quotients. f:E->R is global C1,gradient f:E->E genuine; hp/hq actual finite-L2 membership. D acts on its actual submodule domain and closure is same original graph closure.
quantifiers: Universal ambient E,finite mu and supplied D subject to closability/exact graph; graph iff forall scalar a/vector H,exists smooth compact phi. Then universal f:C1 with hp/hq MemLp proofs. Conclusion the specific ordered hp.toLp f,hq.toLp gradient f pair belongs to SAME D.closure.graph. No existential replacement D,function,gradient or class.
assumptions: IsFiniteMeasure mu,D.IsClosable,exact original smooth compact gradient graph; global ContDiff R 1 f; actual MemLp f2mu and MemLp gradient f2mu. No compact support of f,no global volumeL1,no norm(x)*f moment,no dense-domain certificate or automatic-L2-from-finiteness premise.
conclusion: Actual f/gradient quotient pair (hp.toLp f,hq.toLp gradient f) is in the original D.closure.graph.
scopes: Same D fixed before C1 input/classes; closure membership output,not premise. Finite arbitrary measure does not alone imply L2 of unbounded f. No representative-only convergence substituted for actual graph relation. No smooth-approximation sequence or density estimate is output; no rough Hessian/core/adjoint/spectral-gap/further inequality/main/composition.
constant_dependencies: Only exact exponent2; no numerical bound/rate or probability normalization. mu finite; function and gradient actual L2 assumptions. Output pair fixed by f and hp/hq; no compact support/radius or moment parameter.
